cds.title: Southern Utah University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

navigator.title: College Navigator - Southern Utah University (fall 2024 admissions summary)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 first-year class): it states an open admission policy for all students (virtually every applicant who completes the application is admitted). The Common Data Set gives no residency or international split for applicants/admits. College Navigator (IPEDS fall 2024) counts differently: 19,080 applicants, 82% admitted, 14% of admits enrolled. No early decision; early action is rolling with no closing date. No waitlist. SUU does not use SAT/ACT in admission decisions (the Common Data Set answers No) and reported no score percentiles. Total undergraduates are 13,176 including part-time and non-degree students; 749 nonresident (international) undergraduates (621 degree-seeking). The fall 2025 first-year class has 127 nonresident students.

cds_test_policy.notes: Test policy from the Common Data Set: SUU does not use SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions; scores are used for advising and placement.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set, first-year 2026-27 (tuition: in-state $6,622, out-of-state $21,550, nonresident $22,630). Aid, also from the Common Data Set: 608 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid (need-based and/or non-need-based), average $10,264, total $6,240,271. SUU's international costs page estimates $32,915 per year for a single international undergraduate (tuition $22,630, fees $645, program/course fees $250, books $1,000, personal $2,000, shared room and block-100 meal plan $6,390)
